title: ci shard follow-ups after the Test Core 10-shard widening: refresh-lane path filter, width-8 self-test rows, stale 1..8 header
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ②: follow-ups the contract review of PR #34727 (Fixes #34710, Test Core matrix 8 → 10) left open, comment 6945222844. Dedupe: `shard-timings-refresh paths` / `plan-test-core-shards 1..8`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p3 · domain:devx · tooling · Blocked-by #34727

## Items

- `.github/workflows/shard-timings-refresh.yml`: its `pull_request.paths` filter should also list `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs`, so a change to the matrix width re-runs the refresh lane's checks.
- N1 — three negative rows in the self-test hard-code a width of 8; if the matrix ever returns to 8 they fail for the wrong reason. Derive the width from the matrix instead.
- N2 — the header comment of `scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs` still says `1..8` in two places.

No behaviour change beyond the path filter.
